title: 贝索斯卸任 CEO 时写给全体员工的信（2021）
topic: 贝索斯卸任 CEO 时写给全体员工的信（2021）

source.title: Email from Jeff Bezos to employees
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Amazon 亚马逊 公开资料。
paragraphs: I’m excited to announce that this Q3 I’ll transition to Executive Chair of the Amazon Board and Andy Jassy will become CEO. In the Exec Chair role, I intend to focus my energies and attention on new products and early initiatives. Andy is well known inside the company and has been at Amazon almost as long as I have. He will be an outstanding leader, and he has my full confidence.

This journey began some 27 years ago. Amazon was only an idea, and it had no name. The question I was asked most frequently at that time was, “What’s the internet?” Blessedly, I haven’t had to explain that in a long while.
Today, we employ 1.3 million talented, dedicated people, serve hundreds of millions of customers and businesses, and are widely recognized as one of the most successful companies in the world.

How did that happen? Invention. Invention is the root of our success. We’ve done crazy things together, and then made them normal. We pioneered customer reviews, 1-Click, personalized recommendations, Prime’s insanely-fast shipping, Just Walk Out shopping, the Climate Pledge, Kindle, Alexa, marketplace, infrastructure cloud computing, Career Choice, and much more. If you get it right, a few years after a surprising invention, the new thing has become normal. People yawn. And that yawn is the greatest compliment an inventor can receive.
translations: 我很高兴地宣布，在今年第三季度，我将转任亚马逊董事会执行主席，安迪·贾西（Andy Jassy）将成为首席执行官。在执行主席的职位上，我打算将我的精力和注意力集中在新产品和早期举措上。安迪在公司内部广为人知，他在亚马逊的任职时间几乎和我一样长。他将是一位出色的领导者，我对他完全信任。
这段旅程始于大约27年前。当时亚马逊只是一个想法，还没有名字。当时我被问得最多的问题是，"互联网是什么？"幸运的是，我已经有很长时间不必解释这个问题了。
今天，我们雇佣了130万才华横溢、敬业的人才，为数亿客户和企业提供服务，并被广泛认为是世界上最成功的公司之一。

这是怎么发生的？创新。创新是我们成功的根源。我们一起做了疯狂的事情，然后使它们变得正常。我们开创了客户评论、一键下单、个性化推荐、Prime超快配送、Just Walk Out购物、气候承诺（Climate Pledge）、Kindle、Alexa、市场、基础设施云计算、职业选择（Career Choice）等等。如果你做对了，在一个令人惊讶的创新几年后，新事物就会变得正常。人们会打哈欠。而这个哈欠是发明者能收到的最大赞美。
fullTextParagraphs: I’m excited to announce that this Q3 I’ll transition to Executive Chair of the Amazon Board and Andy Jassy will become CEO. In the Exec Chair role, I intend to focus my energies and attention on new products and early initiatives. Andy is well known inside the company and has been at Amazon almost as long as I have. He will be an outstanding leader, and he has my full confidence.

This journey began some 27 years ago. Amazon was only an idea, and it had no name. The question I was asked most frequently at that time was, “What’s the internet?” Blessedly, I haven’t had to explain that in a long while.
Today, we employ 1.3 million talented, dedicated people, serve hundreds of millions of customers and businesses, and are widely recognized as one of the most successful companies in the world.

How did that happen? Invention. Invention is the root of our success. We’ve done crazy things together, and then made them normal. We pioneered customer reviews, 1-Click, personalized recommendations, Prime’s insanely-fast shipping, Just Walk Out shopping, the Climate Pledge, Kindle, Alexa, marketplace, infrastructure cloud computing, Career Choice, and much more. If you get it right, a few years after a surprising invention, the new thing has become normal. People yawn. And that yawn is the greatest compliment an inventor can receive.

I don’t know of another company with an invention track record as good as Amazon’s, and I believe we are at our most inventive right now. I hope you are as proud of our inventiveness as I am. I think you should be.

As Amazon became large, we decided to use our scale and scope to lead on important social issues. Two high-impact examples: our $15 minimum wage and the Climate Pledge. In both cases, we staked out leadership positions and then asked others to come along with us. In both cases, it’s working. Other large companies are coming our way. I hope you’re proud of that as well.

I find my work meaningful and fun. I get to work with the smartest, most talented, most ingenious teammates. When times have been good, you’ve been humble. When times have been tough, you’ve been strong and supportive, and we’ve made each other laugh. It is a joy to work on this team.

As much as I still tap dance into the office, I’m excited about this transition. Millions of customers depend on us for our services, and more than a million employees depend on us for their livelihoods. Being the CEO of Amazon is a deep responsibility, and it’s consuming. When you have a responsibility like that, it’s hard to put attention on anything else. As Exec Chair I will stay engaged in important Amazon initiatives but also have the time and energy I need to focus on the Day 1 Fund, the Bezos Earth Fund, Blue Origin, The Washington Post, and my other passions. I’ve never had more energy, and this isn’t about retiring. I’m super passionate about the impact I think these organizations can have.

Amazon couldn’t be better positioned for the future. We are firing on all cylinders, just as the world needs us to. We have things in the pipeline that will continue to astonish. We serve individuals and enterprises, and we’ve pioneered two complete industries and a whole new class of devices. We are leaders in areas as varied as machine learning and logistics, and if an Amazonian’s idea requires yet another new institutional skill, we’re flexible enough and patient enough to learn it.
Keep inventing, and don’t despair when at first the idea looks crazy. Remember to wander. Let curiosity be your compass. It remains Day 1.

notes.explain: 公司治理结构中的高级职位，通常负责董事会事务和战略方向，而非日常运营管理
notes.example: After serving as CEO for 15 years, she transitioned to the role of Executive Chair to focus on long-term strategy.

notes.phrase: name. The question I was asked
notes.meaning: 幸运的是，我已经很久不必解释那件事了。
notes.explain: 表达一种解脱感，表示某事物曾经需要频繁解释但现在已成为常识
notes.example: Blessedly, I haven't had to explain how to use a smartphone in a long while; it's become second nature to everyone.

notes.meaning: 有才华、有奉献精神的人才
notes.explain: 描述员工的双重特质：专业能力和工作态度
notes.example: Our company's success is built on employing talented, dedicated people who are passionate about their work.

notes.phrase: the greatest compliment an inventor can receive
notes.meaning: 发明者能收到的最大赞美
notes.explain: 指当一项创新发明变得如此普遍以至于人们习以为常、不再感到惊讶时，这恰恰证明了发明的成功
notes.example: When people no longer marvel at your groundbreaking technology and simply take it for granted, that yawn is the greatest compliment an inventor can receive.

scenario.title: Explain Bezos’s 2021 leadership transition
english: A colleague asks what Jeff Bezos planned to do after stepping down as Amazon CEO in 2021.
You explain that Andy Jassy would become CEO, while Bezos would become Executive Chair and focus on new products and early initiatives.
You also mention that Bezos expressed full confidence in Jassy as his successor.
chinese: 一位同事问，Jeff Bezos 在 2021 年卸任 Amazon CEO 后准备做什么。
你说明 Andy Jassy 将接任 CEO，Bezos 则转任执行主席，专注新产品和早期项目。
你还提到 Bezos 表示完全信任继任者 Jassy。

firstAttempt.prompt: 同事问 Jeff Bezos 在宣布卸任 Amazon CEO 时如何介绍交接安排。请用英文说明谁接任、Bezos 之后关注什么，以及他对继任者的态度。
firstAttempt.sample: Andy Jassy would become CEO, while Bezos would move into the Executive Chair role and focus on new products and early initiatives. Bezos said Jassy had his full confidence.
firstAttempt.rationale: 这是对 2021 年交接邮件的概括，不将历史信件改写成你自己的退休公告。

words.example: She will transition from her role as CFO to CEO next month.
words.translation: 她下个月将从首席财务官的职位过渡到首席执行官。
words.note: 常用于描述职位、状态或阶段的转变，强调过程而非结果

words.example: As she approaches retirement, she plans to focus her energies on her charitable foundation.
words.translation: 随着退休年龄临近，她计划将自己的精力投入到她的慈善基金会中。
words.note: 复数形式常用于表达将多种精力或资源集中投入到某事

words.example: His outstanding leadership during the crisis earned him the respect of the entire organization.
words.translation: 他在危机期间的出色领导赢得了整个组织的尊重。
words.note: 比"excellent"程度更深，强调在同类中脱颖而出

words.example: We are looking for a dedicated professional who is willing to go the extra mile for our clients.
words.translation: 我们正在寻找一位愿意为客户多走一步的敬业专业人士。
words.note: 形容人对工作或事业的全心投入和忠诚

words.example: Customer satisfaction is the root of our company's long-term success.
words.translation: 客户满意度是我们公司长期成功的根本。
words.note: 指事物最基本、最核心的原因或基础

words.example: What was once considered innovative has now become normal in our industry.
words.translation: 曾经被视为创新的事物现在在我们的行业中已经变得司空见惯。
words.note: 描述从创新到被广泛接受和采用的过程

structure.original: I’m excited to announce that this Q3 I’ll transition to Executive Chair of the Amazon Board and Andy Jassy will become CEO.
analysis: 主句结构：'I'm excited to announce' 是主句，其中'excited'是形容词作表语，'to announce'是不定式短语作原因状语
宾语从句：'that this Q3 I'll transition to Executive Chair of the Amazon Board and Andy Jassy will become CEO'是announce的宾语从句，由连词'that引导'
并列结构：从句中包含两个并列分句，由'and'连接，分别是'I'll transition to Executive Chair of the Amazon Board'和'Andy Jassy will become CEO'
structure.transfer: Jordan will take over as project lead next month while I move into an advisory role.

rewrite.bad: Bezos left Amazon immediately without naming a successor or explaining his next role.
rewrite.good: Andy Jassy would become CEO. Bezos would become Executive Chair, focus on new products and early initiatives, and said Jassy had his full confidence.
rewrite.translation: Andy Jassy 将接任 CEO。Bezos 将担任董事会执行主席，专注新产品和早期项目，并表示完全信任 Jassy。
rewrite.pattern: [Successor] would take over as CEO, while [the outgoing leader] would focus on [new responsibilities].

cloze.prompt: Jordan will take ___ as project lead next month.
cloze.why: take over as... 表示接任某个职位或责任。
move into an advisory role 表示转为顾问角色。

cloze.prompt: I’m confident the team is in good ___.
cloze.why: in good hands 表示由值得信任的人负责。
